skill.name: generate-assets
skill.description: Generate website images and visual assets with Replicate FLUX 1.1 Pro, then optimize and save them as WebP files.
skill.summary: Generate, optimize, and save AI-created website assets for components.
skill.author: AayushBaniya2006

security_audit.summary: Most static command and environment-file alerts are false positives from Markdown backticks, TypeScript template literals, and setup instructions. Real issues remain in the asset script: unvalidated folder and filename arguments can write outside the intended images directory, and generated image URLs are downloaded without host validation. The skill also disables moderation for background removal and instructs unpinned dependency installs.

remediation.issue: Path traversal in output path construction
remediation.suggestion: Normalize folder and filename inputs, reject absolute paths and .. segments, resolve the output path, and verify it stays under public/assets/images before mkdir or write.
Allow only data URLs or HTTPS URLs from expected Replicate and background-removal hosts. Reject private IPs, unexpected protocols, and unknown hosts.
Enable provider moderation for background removal or require explicit user confirmation before processing transparent assets with moderation disabled.
Pin tested versions for replicate and sharp, and ask for confirmation before changing package.json or lockfiles.

semantic_findings.title: Path Traversal Write Risk
semantic_findings.description: The script accepts folder and filename from CLI arguments and joins them into output paths without bounding them to public/assets/images. A crafted value can create directories or write a .webp outside the intended asset directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The folder and filename arguments directly influence targetDir and filePath. The code then calls mkdirSync and writeFileSync without rejecting absolute paths or .. traversal.

semantic_findings.title: Content Moderation Disabled For Background Removal
semantic_findings.description: The background removal request sets content_moderation to false when transparent assets are generated. This can process unsafe image content without the provider moderation gate.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The provider request explicitly sets content_moderation: false. The behavior is limited to the background removal branch, so the confidence is high but scoped.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Dependency Installation Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs users to run pnpm add replicate and pnpm add sharp -D without versions. This modifies the project dependency graph and pulls current package releases at install time.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The installation commands are explicit and unpinned. The risk is supply-chain and project mutation rather than direct malicious behavior.

content.value_statement: Creating consistent website imagery can slow down component work. This skill generates, optimizes, and saves WebP assets with Replicate and Sharp.
actual_capabilities: Generates images with the black-forest-labs/flux-1.1-pro Replicate model.
Enhances prompts with modern UI styling, patterns, and decorative elements.
Detects existing image dimensions and matches the replacement aspect ratio.
Creates transparent foreground assets using the bria/remove-background model.
Optimizes generated images into WebP files with Sharp.
Saves assets under public/assets/images with optional subfolders.
limitations: Requires a valid REPLICATE_API_TOKEN and network access to Replicate.
Generated image quality and style depend on third-party model output.
The current script needs stricter validation for folder and filename inputs.
It is designed for web imagery, not full design system management.

use_cases.title: Create page hero imagery
use_cases.description: Generate wide WebP images for landing pages, dashboards, and product sections.

use_cases.title: Explore feature visuals
use_cases.description: Produce square or rectangular concept images for cards, feature blocks, and interface previews.

use_cases.title: Prepare transparent decorations
use_cases.description: Create foreground assets with removed backgrounds for accents, icons, and visual polish.

prompt_templates.title: Basic hero asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a wide page image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an asset for a modern analytics dashboard hero section with a clean interface and bright product focus.

prompt_templates.title: Feature card image
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a specific component asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a feature showcase image for AI content generation with real-time preview, polished UI panels, and a square aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: Transparent foreground element
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a reusable decorative asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a transparent foreground asset with subtle stars and geometric accents for a SaaS landing page.

prompt_templates.title: Replace existing visual
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that should preserve dimensions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the existing transformation image with a before-and-after workflow visual and match the current file dimensions.

output_examples.input: Create a 16:9 hero image for a financial dashboard.
output_examples.output: A polished dashboard hero image is generated, optimized as WebP, and saved in the hero assets folder.

output_examples.input: Generate a transparent decorative star cluster for a foreground layer.
output_examples.output: A foreground WebP asset is created with the background removed and transparency preserved.

output_examples.input: Refresh an existing feature image while keeping the same dimensions.
output_examples.output: The existing image dimensions are detected, and the replacement asset is generated at a matching aspect ratio.

best_practices: Describe the main subject, page context, and intended component type in each prompt.
Use named folders that match asset purpose, such as hero, features, or foreground.
Review generated images before publishing them in user-facing pages.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague prompts when the asset must represent a specific product or workflow.
Do not pass untrusted folder or filename values without validating the output path.
Do not assume generated images meet brand, accessibility, or legal requirements without review.

faq.question: What models does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses FLUX 1.1 Pro for generation and BRIA background removal for transparent assets.

faq.question: Where are generated assets saved?
faq.answer: The script saves WebP files under public/assets/images, with optional subfolders for asset types.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN in the environment before generation can run.

faq.question: Can it match an existing image size?
faq.answer: Yes. If the target image exists, the script reads its dimensions and uses a matching aspect ratio.

faq.question: Can it make transparent assets?
faq.answer: Yes. Transparent mode runs a background removal model and preserves alpha when possible.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with any path values?
faq.answer: No. Folder and filename values should be validated before writing files in the current version.
